verdict.rationale: Paxos docs say API credentials use a Client ID and Secret, and that you can set allowed scopes so those credentials reach only specific API endpoints. Tokens are generated through OAuth 2.0, so an agent can be given scoped, least-privilege credentials. The evidence is a few short doc snippets and nothing agent-specific. Missing for 10: detail on scope granularity, credential expiry, rotation and revocation, any agent-specific credential guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
